prompt: List down all process, activities and tasks involved in
judge_reasoning: PROMPT ANCHOR: "List down all process, activities and tasks involved in". CONSTRAINT CHECKLIST: (1) Provide a list of processes, activities, and tasks; (2) keep it relevant to the implied (unspecified) subject rather than substituting irrelevant content. Candidate [1] does not list processes/activities/tasks and instead asks for clarification, so it fails the core request. Candidate [3] provides a coherent, comprehensive software-development lifecycle breakdown (best relevance and usefulness), Candidate [2] also lists many items but is degraded by intentionally nonsensical/anti-practice bullets, and Candidate [4] includes fantasy/irrelevant elements that make the list substantially off-target.
